# ADPList

> > ADPList is a free global mentorship platform connecting learners with 32,000+ verified mentors across design, product, engineering, and AI disciplines.

ADPList democratizes access to world-class mentorship by offering free one-on-one sessions with experienced professionals across 140 countries. The platform also provides curated learning resources, including courses and guides on AI-native design, coding for designers, and proven design methodologies from leading tech companies.

## Key Topics

## Platform & Mentorship

- [ADPList Homepage](https://adplist.org): ADPList homepage: free mentorship platform with 32k mentors in design, AI, PM, engineering.
- [About ADPList](https://adplist.org/about-us): ADPList mission and platform overview with 32k mentors across 140 countries.
- [Explore Mentors](https://adplist.org/explore): Explore and discover verified mentors in UX design, PM, engineering, AI, marketing.
- [Become a Mentor](https://adplist.org/become-a-mentor): Join ADPList as a mentor and share expertise in design, product, engineering, AI.

## Learning Resources & Courses

- [Vibe Coding for Designers](https://adplist.org/ai-course): 7-day vibe coding course: designers learn to code with Claude Code and Cursor.
- [Design by Intelligence](https://adplist.org/design-by-intelligence): Free ebook guide: AI-native design tools, prompts, and workflows for designers.
- [Design Moonshot Guide](https://adplist.org/design-moonshot-guide): Design Moonshot playbook: proven tactics from Duolingo, Uber, Airbnb, Notion.

## Community & Content

- [ADPList Blog](http://blog.adplist.org): ADPList blog hub: career advice, design stories, and professional development content.
